column1: # The extras list (plan unsafe-mode.md §4.1, D3, D8): recipes for a declared
# command that no Kali package puts on PATH. A closed set of two kinds,
# tab-separated, one command per row:
#   pip   <command>  <pypi-name>==<exact version>
#   link  <command>  <kali package>  <path inside the package, as Contents lists it>
# The CLI (Unsafe Mode M2) installs a pip row into /opt/agentry/venv and
# links its command into /usr/local/bin, and links a link row's path into
# /usr/local/bin once the package is installed. make-index.py refuses any
# other kind or shape, and a link path the package does not ship, on each
# architecture the image is built for. The CLI resolves a declared command
# here first, then in the index.
# Maintained by hand. A row is added when a published QuickAgent needs a tool
# that no package ships, with the reason beside it.
# Python 2.7-3.8 bytecode decompilers, not packaged by Kali or Debian.
# They install and start on Kali's python3 (3.14), checked 2026-09-30.
pip
pip
# Ghidra's headless analyzer ships in Kali's ghidra package under
# usr/share/ghidra, off PATH (read from Contents-amd64 and Contents-arm64,
link
